settings.editor: Orders are packed in Kampala and sent out across Uganda. Orders placed before 15:00 are dispatched the same working day.
Message us with your order number and we will sort it out. We reply within one working day.

Delivery areas and charges

We deliver to every district in Uganda. Kampala, Wakiso and Entebbe are covered by our own riders, and everywhere else goes through a courier partner. The exact charge for your area is shown at checkout before you pay.

AreaTiming
Kampala deliverySame or next day
Wakiso delivery1 to 2 working days
Entebbe delivery1 to 2 working days
Upcountry courier2 to 4 working days
Pick up in KampalaReady within 24 hours, free

How delivery works

You place your order and receive an email confirmation with your order number. We confirm stock and payment, pack your order and message you when it is on its way. Our rider or the courier calls the number on your order when they arrive.

Please use a phone number that will be reachable on the day, and add a landmark to your address. Landmarks are far more useful to a rider than a street name.

Missed deliveries

If we cannot reach you, the rider will try again the same day and we will call to arrange a new time. After two failed attempts we hold the order for collection and contact you.

Packaging

Orders are packed in plain, unbranded outer packaging. Glass bottles are wrapped individually. If anything arrives damaged, photograph it and contact us within 48 hours and we will replace it.
